about: What the database lets a phone read and write, and what it changes on the way in, as requests over PostgREST. Run against the real migrations by scripts/server-rules.mjs (the db job) and against the test server by src/data/testing/serverRules.test.ts: both must answer every case as written here (QA-06). Ids are names; on the database every uuid column gets md5(name).
